map.08 Public Facilities & Institutions (hos: a hospital occupies this block; its post-storm state is whether the hospital is operating (hospital_ok) or out of service from its own power loss, flooding or structural damage (hospital_down); calls about nearby houses do not by themselves describe the hospital
map.08 Public Facilities & Institutions (sch: a school designated as a hurricane evacuation center; after landfall such sites are normally opened as public shelters (shelter_open) unless the block's own reports show the building damaged or flooded

rationale.hypothesis: Jev does not treat the block's own PLUTO '08 Public Facilities & Institutions' land use as the thing the block's status is about, so hospital_ok (17%) and shelter_open (38%) blocks get labeled from whatever incident reports sit nearby (e.g. a hospital_ok block with a 911 fire call and a de-energized feed is called fire at 0.97). Each of these rare states weighs 1/12 of balanced accuracy. Glossing the two facility land-use values to say that on such a block the key question is the facility's operating status (hospital operating vs out of service; school/evacuation center opened as a shelter) should let Jev pick the facility states when the block's own evidence does not show the facility failing.
rationale.refuted_if: hospital_ok and shelter_open together gain fewer than 4 correct blocks, or hospital_down drops by more than 2 blocks, or balanced accuracy rises by less than 0.5 points, or false dispatches rise by more than 5.

prediction.states: hospital_ok should rise from ~17% toward 40-50% and shelter_open from ~38% toward 55-65%, since the block's own facility land use will now read as the subject of the call; hospital_down should stay near 90% because the gloss says to call it out of service when the block's own reports show power loss or damage. Other states should be flat, since only 08 land-use lines change and they appear on few blocks.
